tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything; the desk the notebook sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas: the person header, dialogs, menus, the reading column of a timeline.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Filled input backgrounds, hover on list rows, the track behind the timeline thread.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and outlined-button borders, the timeline thread. Meets 3:1 on paper and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, surface, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, relationship labels, helper text, metadata. On paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: Blue-black ink, the brand colour. Primary buttons, links, the selected nav item, interaction markers, reminders. As text on paper, surface and pen-soft.

tokens.name: on-pen
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pen fill (primary button label). Never use literal white.

tokens.name: pen-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind pen text: selected nav item, today's reminders, the monogram avatar default.

tokens.name: pencil
tokens.usage: Pencil ochre, the colour of notes. Note labels and the outline of note markers; as text on surface, paper and pencil-soft.

tokens.name: pencil-mark
tokens.usage: Fill of the square note marker only. Too light for text or for a mark on its own in the light theme: always outlined with pencil.

tokens.name: pencil-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind pinned notes (key facts) and note tags.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Difficult moments: the hollow diamond marker, labels and status. As text on surface, paper and plum-soft. Never used for errors.

tokens.name: plum-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a difficult moment's reflection block and plum tags.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations and the resolved status. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Overdue reminders and non-blocking warnings. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Validation errors and destructive actions (delete person). Always paired with text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in the page colour. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Underlined, so they never rely on colour alone.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: The dark modules of a QR code (two-factor setup). The same in both themes: scanners need dark modules on a light ground.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: The light ground and quiet zone of a QR code. White in both themes, so the code scans from a dark-theme screen too.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: A person's name on their profile. One per page.

styles.name: entry
styles.sample: Talked about her move to Lisbon. She starts at the new studio in March.
styles.usage: Anything the user wrote: interaction descriptions, notes, difficult moments.

styles.name: entry-reflection
styles.sample: I interrupt when I'm tired. Next time, ask before giving advice.
styles.usage: Lessons learned on a difficult moment. Italic marks reflection, nothing else.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, person names in lists.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Relio reminds you before birthdays and when it has been a while.
styles.usage: Interface copy, list rows, form values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, form labels, nav items. Sentence case.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, relationship type, counts. In text-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text under fields, tag labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; tag padding block. MudBlazor's spacing unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row padding block; between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between timeline entries; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above a page title; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and status chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus. MudBlazor DefaultBorderRadius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the person header, bottom sheets on phones.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Monogram avatars and interaction markers only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: dialogs, menus, popovers, snackbars. Nothing that sits on the page has a shadow.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the timeline reading column (about 65 characters of entry text).

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Navigation drawer width on desktop.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of dashboard and list pages.
